paper.central_claim: A unified self-evolving mechanism lets one practitioner feedback signal drive two parallel pathways (memory-to-knowledge distillation and targeted Skill refinement) so that the knowledge base and event-to-(data,knowledge) mapping co-evolve; deployed on Kuaishou e-commerce search it cuts alerts 75%, reaches 80% RCA accuracy, halves MTTR and passes 99.0% of 104 offline cases.
paper.title: Bian Que: An Agentic Framework with Flexible Skill Arrangement for Online System Operations

gap.author_gap: LLM O&M agents assume a curated context; real bottleneck is selecting event-specific data and knowledge, and hand-maintaining the mapping is intractable under dozens of releases a day.
gap.checked_gap: Concrete and practical (context assembly for O&M; static Skill pool versus drifting traffic), but the 'dilution/hallucination from feeding all signals' premise is asserted, not measured against an all-signals baseline; closest neighbours (RCAgent, self-evolving memory systems, skill-library agents) are cited rather than compared.
gap.lineage: AIOps anomaly/RCA pipelines -> LLM RCA agents (RCAgent) -> memory/skill-evolving agents; this paper adds LLM-generated/updated data-routing Skills plus feedback-driven knowledge distillation.
gap.closest_adjacent: RCAgent-type reasoners (which could plug in as f_LLM) and single-pathway self-evolving memory work [39-41]; skill-library agents are not discussed by name in the read text.
gap.residue: Event-to-context mapping drifts as systems change; static mapping loses accuracy (author's 13-day frozen arm).
gap.stakes: Pager load and MTTR for ~100 engineers; author reports 80% of fired alerts non-actionable pre-deployment.
gap.method_response: Skills as editable context-assembly units + feedback routed to Skill vs knowledge pathway.
gap.remaining_gap: Quantified benefit of the two-pathway coupling, autonomy without human feedback, regression safety of Skill edits, comparison with other context-assembly or memory baselines.
gap.unresolved: Whether LLM-only (no human) feedback would sustain accuracy; relative value vs strong RAG/all-signals baseline.

G.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. The bottleneck (selecting event-specific data and knowledge rather than reasoning; a drifting event-to-(data, knowledge) mapping) is concrete, and the frozen arm's decay supports it. M.reason: Opus sides with son55. The Skill structure (LoadDataSchema + Prompt + Meta) and the failure-mode routing are reconstructible, which is what sol's 3 credited. But the routing hinges on an attribution step that is not specified (opus:O01), Skill matching is keyword-based, and the paper's own distinguishing claim (one signal driving two co-evolving pathways beats separate pipelines) is argued as convenience and left untested by the authors (son55:E007). Key assumptions remain weak: anchor 2.

X.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Generation with execution validation (≤3 retries), NL updates, short-term case memory and daily consolidation are described and read back on later events. No regression check or rollback for Skill edits, no admission gate for knowledge entries, and the Meta 'version' field has no stated semantics.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. SRE-annotated ground truth on 104 production events and production KPIs are meaningful. Limits: pass@k counts an event as passed if any of k Skill generations yields the ground-truth diagnosis (oracle selection); RCA accuracy is 'confirmed by practitioners' with no protocol or agreement; online KPIs are normalised relatives; suppressed-alert recall is absent; Table 6's overall count disagrees with its groups (opus:O02).

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Static (hand-written fixed Skills) and NoKnow arms on the same 104 events and a 13-day feedback on/off arm are relevant store-off style contrasts for the retained Skills/knowledge. The headline online KPIs are pre/post with no concurrent control and are attributed by the authors mainly to release interception and inspection, the Static Skills' authorship and budget are unstated, the two pathways are not separated, and no alternative context-assembly baseline exists.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. The 104-event set serves generation, retries, the SRE corrections behind the 97.1%/99.0% figures, and the ablations; the knowledge-base state during the offline runs is not described (only the Skill directory is reset).
